g.text: Why fewer target calls do not guarantee faster decoding
Qwen2.5 1.5B target / 0.5B draft · RTX 4060 Laptop · BF16 · F09, 2K, k = 4, 64 output tokens
Three repeats; one development input. (a) Bars: medians; dots: individual repeats. (b,d) Arithmetic means preserve additive accounting.
Prefill excluded. Instrumented and uninstrumented timings are separate; no CPU/GPU bottleneck or universal speedup claim.
